## 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026-06-12: SPCX listed at $135, then hit an all-time high of $225.64 on June 16. Since then it has trended down toward the $135-150 area. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Initial_public_offering_of_SpaceX), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/spacex)

- With daily moves of roughly 2-4% and occasional moves of 5-9%, a 4.5% gain over three sessions is about a one-standard-deviation move. That kind of move is common for this stock, but it would mean recovering from two down days.
- Over early to mid September the stock traded roughly between $143 and $153. The $150 level was within that range.
